falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes below 4,800 on any day in the next 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A break below the August 2024 lows would invalidate the 77% pattern match to that bottom, as the structure would have failed to hold support and the presumed accumulation zone would be broken

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes above 35 for 2 consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A sustained volatility spike above 35 would indicate panic selling rather than bottoming behavior, contradicting the low blowoff score of 39 which suggests complacency/weak-handed selling typical of bottoms, not capitulation

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y Treasury yield drops below 3.50% and holds there for 3+ consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A flight-to-quality bid driving yields sharply lower would signal recession/de-risking panic rather than the soft-landing/growth-stabilization dynamic implied by an August 2024-style bottom pattern

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
